{"body":"## Summary

Since #292, an elided `typescript` call and its result appear in the model's context as assistant text, for example:

```
[Pit: elided tool call: typescript · ~739 tokens with its result · reason: absorbed into assistant replies and note state-2026-11-18 · originals: session.inspectEntry("3c47487c"), session.inspectEntry("7ba62e94")]
```

In a long session with many of these, the model started writing that same text itself at the end of a turn, where it meant to call the tool. The message then has **no tool call**, so nothing runs, but the transcript renders it exactly like an elided call. The model (and the person reading the transcript) took each one as a completed action. #292 fixed models copying the placeholder *as a tool argument*; this is the text form being copied instead, with a worse failure mode: no error, no retry, a silent no-op.

## Impact

In one session (pi 1.5.2, pit `git:github.com/cv/pit@main`, extension changelog 0.37.0, model `claude-opus-5-5` via `nvidia-internal/azure/anthropic`), it happened at least 4 times in the session file, plus more earlier that were only caught later:

| Assistant entry | Time (UTC) | Tool calls in the message | What the model believed it did |
|---|---|---|---|
| `e27e2e44` | 2026-11-18 06:45 | 0 | started two helper agents and closed a pull request |
| `e67f9b8a` | 2026-11-18 06:53 | 0 | started a read-only helper agent |
| `079f2e53` | 2026-11-18 10:19 | 0 | started a helper agent |
| `7e70ea50` | 2026-11-18 10:25","comments":[{"author":"cv","body":"@pi do you have enough information to reproduce this issue? and come up with a PR for a fix?"},{"author":"pi-action-agent","body":"### 🤖 pi Response

Yes, the issue had enough detail to reproduce it, and the fix is up as PR [#410](https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/410). All local checks pass, including tests and coverage. CI fails on Node 22, but in the dependency audit step, not in this change; Node 24 and 26 were still running when I last checked.

**Reproduction:** step 4 of the issue is the exact trigger. It's a finished assistant reply with no tool call whose last line starts with `[Pit: elided tool call`. Before the fix, Pit did nothing at the end of such a turn, so the run stopped with nothing executed and no notice. "}],"state":"OPEN","title":"Models imitate elided calls rendered as text: they write the placeholder instead of calling the tool, and nothing runs"}

- The release has one change since v0.38.0, commit `ac49133`: when a `typescript` call puts its label or options in a `// @pit: {...}` header, the call display now shows them.
- Local check, tests, coverage an"}],"state":"OPEN","title":"new patch release"}
value.p410:
{"body":"Refs #409. Not closing yet: this changes what the model and the transcript see, so it needs a live Pi check first.

## Reproduction

The issue gives enough to reproduce this without the session file. Its step 4 test is the trigger: a completed assistant message whose last text line is an `[Pit: elided tool call…]` record and that has no `toolCall` block. Before this change, Pit's `turn_end` boundary returned nothing for such a message, so the run settled with no tool result and no notice. The new test `test/globals/imitated-calls.test.ts` builds that exact message on a real Pi `SessionManager`. A mutation probe that disables the notice makes its two positive tests fail (`expected undefined to be true`).

## Changes

- **Detect it and say so (proposal 1).** `src/context/imitated-calls.ts` flags a completed reply that makes no tool call and whose last line starts with the elided-call prefix. At `turn_end`, Pit appends a `pit.imitated-call` notice saying no tool ran and the action did not happen, and returns `continue: true` so the model gets one more response to make the call.
  - **Loop guard:** if the reply right after a notice repeats the mistake, it gets the notice again but no c","closes":[],"title":"Notice replies that write an elided-call record instead of calling a tool (#409)"}
